paper_read.why: A states GameWikiSum uses Wikipedia gameplay sections as targets restricted to gameplay mechanics [1], and contracts corpus uses first author with 3 years contract drafting experience to select most informative summary among alternatives [2]; synthesis (section standardization vs expert selection) is present. Citations point to valid passages supporting each claim.

one_pass.why: B correctly describes GameWikiSum gameplay-section targets and matching rules, but for contracts it only says summaries were reviewed by the experienced first author and explicitly denies knowing how a target is retained; it omits the expert selection of the most informative summary among alternatives, so fact_b and synthesis fail. Citations for contracts do not support the selection mechanism.
